usage.description: This file configures the inference rules for the hybrid graph query service
howToUse: 1. Load this JSON file in the hybrid service
2. Direct connections (labels like 'חלק מ-') get highest priority
3. Inference rules are applied as SECONDARY information
4. Each rule has an enabled flag that can be toggled
5. Weight determines the confidence level of inferences
6. Search terms help identify relevant nodes in the graph
usage.activation: Pass this configuration to the hybridChatGraph function as the inferenceRules parameter
usage.fixedIssue: משטרת בית שמש חלק ממצודות טיגארט - קשר ישיר יוצג תחילה
